description.value: Kohan Reflection Garden is a publicly accessible garden in the Kootenays region of British Columbia, tagged in OpenStreetMap as a leisure garden with open public access. Its name suggests a reflective or contemplative landscape, making it a likely rest stop for touring cyclists passing through the area. No further detail could be confirmed due to the website being unreachable.
